prompts.name: air-grip
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the raised wand hand/grip in each of these FOUR frames. Preserve all four full bodies, same grid, head and upward gaze, arm position, wand position, colors, proportions, transparent background. The current hand looks like open fingers stacked next to a stick. Draw a small natural CLOSED FIST wrapping AROUND the vertical wand: four fingers curl across and behind the shaft, thumb crosses over the fingers, the black handle disappears inside the palm and a short end exits below the fist. Knuckles face viewer, wrist straight continuing the forearm; do not bend hand backwards. Same closed grip all four frames. No other arm changes, no extra limbs, no new effects. Keep the entire existing sprite strip and true transparency.

prompts.name: crouch-arms
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair the SECOND frame ONLY (second character from left) in this four-frame sprite strip. It currently switches wand-holding arms. Match the FIRST frame exactly: the FAR arm (on viewer's right, starting at the shoulder behind her chest) holds wand horizontally right; the NEAR arm bends DOWN with its hand resting on her front knee. No arm crosses the blouse or red bow. Keep first, third and fourth frame unchanged. Second frame head, eyes, face, hat, torso position, knee/boot position, wand and star remain unchanged; replace only its two arms with those of the first frame, tiny 2px recoil permitted. Exactly two arms and two hands each character. Closed hand holds shaft, not pointing index finger. Preserve transparent background and exact strip framing.

prompts.name: down-arms
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair frames TWO and THREE ONLY in this four-character strip. Match the correct FIRST and FOURTH frames: the FAR arm on viewer's RIGHT holds wand down-right; NEAR arm on viewer's LEFT hangs down in FRONT beside skirt with its closed hand visible beside thigh. Remove the hand/fist behind her butt entirely. In frame2 the wrong near arm crossing chest is replaced by the correct far shoulder/arm, and the empty arm hangs in front exactly as frame1. In frame3 remove extra third hand behind skirt and keep only two anatomically connected arms, free arm lowered beside thigh like frame1. Exactly two arms and two hands, no arm across red bow. Keep all other artwork, face/downward gaze, feet, proportions, wand star locations, four-frame strip layout, first and fourth frames unchanged. Transparent background.

prompts.name: organ-body
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-drawn 2D platformer boss BODY sprite, single large object filling a 1024x1024 transparent image. Circus barrel-organ engine body with a crisp simple silhouette, burgundy red painted wood, chunky antique gold/brass trims, large exposed teal accordion bellows in the center, three broad red-and-gold side ribs, a short burgundy carnival marquee roof with ONE large gold star. Front-facing broad side view appropriate for a machine attacking LEFT. A wide low wheeled-vehicle chassis with bumper, but DO NOT DRAW WHEELS (separate sprites will be attached). DO NOT DRAW PIPES OR HORNS (separate animated parts attach later). The body has a simple large rectangular central opening exposing the teal accordion; no door covering it. Clear large shapes, sharp ink contours, gentle painted shading consistent with colorful illustrated anime fairy-tale game, NOT photoreal, NOT blurry tiny ornate detail. No clowns, humans, characters, faces, eyes, operator windows, keyboard, text, decals, clouds, smoke, background, shadow or extra objects. Main chassis is sturdy, memorable toy-like mechanical antagonist, rich but restrained shading; fewer big shapes so readable at 350px tall. Entire single body visible with margins, straight camera, no perspective floor, true alpha.

prompts.name: organ-parts
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make a matching modular 2D game sprite kit for this circus organ body. EXACT same crisp burgundy wood, chunky brass gold trim, clean ink line and softly painted shading. Transparent background. Exactly FOUR disconnected objects laid out in a generous 2x2 grid, all complete with large transparent gutters. TOP LEFT: one large round wagon wheel, dark burgundy outer tire, gold brass rim, SIX thick spokes, round gold hub, perfectly circular seen straight-on. TOP RIGHT: one connected bank of THREE tall upright brass musical exhaust pipes with FLARED OPEN TRUMPET BELL mouths pointing UP, middle pipe taller, joined at a small red base. BOTTOM LEFT: a rectangular upright burgundy armored shutter with rounded brass frame and ONE simple big golden star in center, front view, width about 3/4 height, no hinges sticking out. BOTTOM RIGHT: a large brass trumpet cannon HORN pointing horizontally LEFT, mouth flared on LEFT end with dark interior opening visible in side/three-quarter view, narrow connector on RIGHT. Four assets only. No assembled machine, no people, no faces, no clowns, no text, no shadows or ground. Individual object occupies most of its own quadrant, high clarity, large shapes, not filigree.

prompts.name: air-grip-thumb
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the exact four-frame sprite strip to fix. Image2 is a magnified view of its WRONG hand: thumb is missing, fingers form a flat comb alongside stick. Repaint this hand in ALL FOUR characters of Image1. Draw a compact anatomical fist: four curled fingers around the shaft and one CLEAR VISIBLE OPPOSABLE THUMB crossing DIAGONALLY OVER the curled index/middle fingers. Thumb pad prominently forms a diagonal oval over the front of the fist, NOT an extra fifth parallel finger. The wand shaft runs through the CENTER of the grip and exits top and bottom. Wrist is continuous with raised forearm. Can alter hand contour/forearm top slightly to correct grip but preserve other body pixels, upward head/gaze and all wand stars, four-frame layout and true transparency. Output full four-character strip, not a hand closeup. No missing thumbs, no mitten, no open pointing fingers.

prompts.name: river-ground
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact panoramic 2D terrain texture. Remove ONLY the FLAT DARK OLIVE GREEN background strip along its very TOP EDGE above the leafy grass. Make that area genuinely TRANSPARENT so the grass silhouette is organic and uneven, each top leaf and grass tuft intact. All foliage, flowers, roots, wood/soil beneath grass must stay the same artwork, colors, sharpness, layout, scale and horizontal panorama aspect. No colored matte band and no straight horizontal line above grass. No new elements, do not redraw the ground, do not change lower soil or roots. Fill entire original width and height, same panoramic framing, preserve original pixel detail as much as possible. True transparent alpha in sky gap above ragged leafy edge only, all soil below remains opaque.

prompts.name: air-grip-final
prompts.prompt: Repair this grip anatomically. The first reference is the WRONG hand enlarged: it has FOUR horizontal parallel fingers and NO thumb. The second image is the full 4-frame animation to output. Redraw every raised hand as a different, CORRECT power grip, with the BACK of the closed fist facing the viewer. Four fingers curl UNDER the wand, and a clearly separated broad THUMB crosses DIAGONALLY DOWN over the curled index and middle fingers on the FRONT of the hand, making a distinct diagonal shape across the knuckles. Five digits total, including this obvious opposing thumb. A black vertical wand shaft passes through the fist, visible above and a short end below. Rotate the fist/forearm if needed; do NOT preserve the old flat finger-comb silhouette. Wrist straight with forearm, compact fist. Keep this same new correct hand throughout ALL FOUR frames. Preserve the full four flying witch figures, tucked knees, upward tilted head/eyes, hair, costume, proportions and existing stars and aim direction. The face, head and body do not change between idle and shot. Output the full transparent four-frame strip at same panorama framing as image2, no closeup panels, no cropped bodies. True transparent background.
